blocks.text: Buying an Apartment Condo in Pitt Meadows: Buildings & Walkability

parts.t: Apartment condos in the City of Pitt Meadows are concentrated almost entirely inside the walkable Central Meadows and Mid Meadows core along Harris Road, Ford Road, McMyn Road, and 190A Street. Residents can walk to Spirit Square, the Pitt Meadows Family Recreation Centre, Library, grocery stores at Meadowvale Shopping Centre, and the Pitt Meadows West Coast Express Station at 12185 Harris Road.

Well-known Pitt Meadows condo buildings include the multi-building Cedar Downs community (12455–12475 191B St and 19090–19130 Ford Rd, built 2011), 12565 190A St (built 2013), 12350 Harris Rd (built 2008), The Fairways (19133–19188 Ford Rd, built 2007), concrete towers at Solaris near Civic Centre, and adult-oriented 55+ buildings along McMyn Road and Ford Road.

blocks.text: Pitt Meadows Condo Strata Checks: Concrete vs. Wood-Frame, Parking & Levies

parts.t: When comparing Pitt Meadows condos for sale, check the construction type (reinforced concrete at Solaris vs. 4-storey rainscreened wood-frame at Cedar Downs or The Fairways), underground parking and storage locker designations on the Form B Information Certificate, strata water-damage insurance deductibles, and whether the building has an age restriction (such as 55+ buildings in Central Meadows).

blocks.text: Frequently Asked Questions About Pitt Meadows Condos for Sale

parts.t: Where are condo buildings located in Pitt Meadows?
Almost all Pitt Meadows apartment condos are located in
Central Meadows
and
Mid Meadows
along Harris Road, Ford Road, McMyn Road, and 190A Street within walking distance of shops, parks, and transit.
What are some of the best-known condo buildings in Pitt Meadows?

Popular Pitt Meadows condo developments include Cedar Downs (built 2011 on Ford Rd and 191B St), Solaris (concrete high-rises near Spirit Square), 12565 190A St (built 2013), 12350 Harris Rd (built 2008), and The Fairways (19133–19188 Ford Rd, built 2007).
Are there concrete high-rise condos in Pitt Meadows?

Yes. The Solaris development near the Civic Centre and Spirit Square in Central Meadows offers concrete construction with mountain and Fraser Valley views, while most other Pitt Meadows apartment buildings are 3- and 4-storey wood-frame buildings.
Can I walk to the West Coast Express from Pitt Meadows condos?
Yes. Condo buildings along Harris Road, Ford Road, McMyn Road, and 190A Street in Central Meadows are within a 3- to 10-minute flat walk of Pitt Meadows West Coast Express Station (12185 Harris Rd).
Are there 55+ age-restricted condos in Pitt Meadows?
Yes. Pitt Meadows has dedicated 55+ age-restricted apartment buildings in Central Meadows near shopping and medical clinics; see our
Pitt Meadows 55+ Condos
page for active listings.
What should I review in the strata documents before buying a Pitt Meadows condo?

We review two years of strata council and general meeting minutes, the Form B Information Certificate (CRF balance, monthly fee, parking/locker stall numbers, and special levies), the Depreciation Report, bylaws (pets, smoking, short-term rentals), and the insurance certificate.
